_comment: Curated catalog of the highest-value Apify actors for the Content Machine. This is the single source of truth for which actors run, what they pull, and how their input is shaped. Signals read templates from here so you can retune targets without touching code. 'key' selects which env credential is used: 'main' = APIFY_CONTENT_MACHINE_KEY, 'tiktok' = APIFY_BENABLE_BOT.

youtube_competitors.value: Top-ranking videos on a topic with view counts, upload dates, durations, channels. Compute views/day velocity to find what is hot NOW. Feeds topic discovery, title patterns, optimal duration, and verified facts (real titles = real events).

youtube_comments.value: Top comments on the best videos for a topic. Surfaces audience questions, disagreements, and content gaps competitors are NOT answering — the richest source of new video angles.

twitter_breaking.disabled_note: Retired 2026-08-14. Measured across all 19 run traces (2026-07-07 to 2026-08-14) the signal was 'inactive' on 19/19 runs — it has never once produced a fact. The actor bills a full run, takes ~32s (the slowest signal, so it set the wall-clock floor for every discovery since signals run concurrently), and returns 10 x {'noResults': true} sentinel rows instead of tweets; X search almost certainly requires authenticated cookies now. The input was verified correct against input_template (searchTerms/sort/maxItems), so this is not the reddit-style input drift. Re-enable only after confirming the actor returns real tweets for a live query — apify_client.is_no_results() now reports the sentinel as STATUS_UNAVAILABLE rather than a quiet 'inactive'.
twitter_breaking.value: Real-time breaking news and viral moments. UFC fight announcements, results, fighter beef; gaming patch reactions and controversy. Highest timeliness of any source — primary fact-grounding for 'just happened' topics.

reddit_community.disabled_note: Retired 2026-08-14. The actor failed ('run did not succeed') on every live run while still billing compute, and the free OAuth backend needs REDDIT_CLIENT_ID/SECRET which are not set. Re-enable by setting those credentials (SIGNAL_BACKEND=auto already prefers free) or by fixing the actor input, which had drifted from input_template: the signal sent searches=[{query,sort}] objects where this template implies flat values.
reddit_community.value: Hot posts + engagement from domain subreddits. Community sentiment, the debates people care about, and the language fans actually use.

tiktok_trends.value: Viral angles, hooks, and hashtag patterns. Shows which framings of a topic are already winning attention in short-form.

instagram_figures.value: Posts from UFC fighters and gaming creators. Fighters announce fights/injuries on IG first; creators tease drops. Optional — enable when chasing athlete/creator-driven stories.
